categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business segments include architectural design services, urban planning, and design consulting. The company provides comprehensive design services covering residential buildings, medical and elderly care facilities, commercial complexes, hotels, office buildings, schools, and cultural facilities. Additionally, the company offers specialized consulting services in areas such as prefabricated buildings, BIM technology, green buildings, sponge cities, and building intelligence.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include Building Information Modeling (BIM) technology, prefabricated building design, green building design, and building intelligence systems. The company employs advanced simulation analysis software for environmental optimization, participates in the development of industry standards and specifications, and has developed proprietary design tools and parameter-based design methods. The company also utilizes VR technology, GIS systems, and AIGC technology in its design processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers include major real estate developers such as Vanke, Poly Group, China Merchants Property, China Resources Land, and Gemdale Group. The company also serves government agencies, state-owned enterprises, and institutional clients including Shenzhen Talent Housing Group and Shenzhen Metro Group. The company serves multiple market segments including residential, commercial, medical, educational, and cultural building sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationally with branch offices established in Beijing, Shanghai, Chongqing, Chengdu, Xi'an, Wuhan, Foshan, Lanzhou, Taiyuan, Zhengzhou, Nanning, Guangzhou, and Huizhou. The company's headquarters is located in Shenzhen, with significant operations in the South China region accounting for 67.98% of revenue. The company has expanded its geographic presence to cover major cities across China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the construction industry value chain, positioned as a design and consulting service provider. The company receives commissions from developers and construction clients to provide design services and technical consulting. The company's services bridge the gap between project conception and construction execution, serving as a critical link in the construction project lifecycle.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes advancing digital transformation through BIM technology and collaborative design platforms, developing green and low-carbon building design capabilities, expanding prefabricated building design services, and exploring emerging technologies such as AIGC and digital twins. The company invests significantly in R&D with 2023 R&D expenditure of 45.87 million yuan. The company emphasizes innovation in design methodologies, technical standards development, and integration of advanced technologies into design processes.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through project-based design service contracts with real estate developers and construction clients. Revenue is recognized using the percentage-of-completion method based on design progress. The company charges fees for various design phases including conceptual design, scheme design, preliminary design, construction drawings, and construction support services. The company also generates revenue from design consulting services and specialized technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading private architectural design enterprise in China, ranking among the top tier of domestic design firms. The company competes with both large state-owned design institutes and other prominent private design firms. The company has received recognition including ranking 2nd in the WA 100 2022 list published by Building Design magazine, and has been recognized as one of the top 100 most influential private enterprises in the construction industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported 2023 revenue of 681.07 million yuan, representing a 22.28% decrease from 2022 revenue of 876.32 million yuan. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 82.99 million yuan in 2023, down 44.54% from 149.65 million yuan in 2022. The company's total assets were 1.886 billion yuan at year-end 2023. The company has experienced revenue decline in 2023 due to challenging market conditions in the real estate sector.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through comprehensive full-lifecycle design services, advanced technical capabilities in BIM and prefabricated building design, and strong brand reputation built on award-winning projects. The company emphasizes the SMART design methodology incorporating sustainability, maintainability, architectural excellence, rationality, and technical innovation. The company's value proposition includes delivering high-quality design solutions that optimize project value, reduce construction costs, and incorporate green and intelligent building technologies.
